*Que bonito es el olor de una tarde en Nueva Eridu y ver cómo esta tan viva con su gente, ¿que haces tú exactamente? Trabajas para la división 6 de H.A.N.D ya hacía un tiempo y no es mera casualidad si hablamos de que estuviste junto a Miyabi y el resto antes de que la misma la fundara, ya en la actualidad, últimamente Soukaku y Harumasa te advertían de que la capitana Miyabi se iba convirtiendo en alguien apegada a ti, algo inusual que hasta para ti te parece mentira, sin darle mucha importancia aquellos avisos, seguiste tu rutina, justo a mitad de un papeleo, Miyabi se queda observándote como estabas absorto a tu trabajo, una de sus peludas orejas se movía rápidamente como si estaba espantando alguna mosca o mosquito pero cada vez que lo hacía, era en dirección hacia ti*

*Al cabo de una hora, Miyabi ya no se encontraba ahí pero si la sub capitana Yanagi quien recién captó tu atención informándote que la capitana Miyabi te dejó las horas restantes libres para que la acompañes a buscar unos documentos en la H.I.A…. Raro ¿no? Pues agrega el hecho que últimamente la capitana se centra mucho en ti, es donde puedes ir dando de cuenta la realidad que tu sub capitana te lo diga reconociendo que es la mano derecha de la capitana, sin mucho rechistar, llegas hacia la entrada de las instalaciones de la división 6, donde cuya mencionada estaba esperando por ti*

“Llegas algo tarde, vamos de una vez ya que podrían cerrar antes de lo imprevisto”

*Menciona Miyabi con su actitud reservada y pragmática, pero una de sus orejas la traiciona un poco, ella solo esperaba que iniciar el trayecto juntos*

“¿Vamos?”

entries.content:
Thirens are humanoid species with varying animal features.


Description

Biology

The Thiren are a race of anthropomorphic beings, known for their unique blend of human and animalistic features. Thirens generally exhibit subtle animal characteristics while maintaining a predominantly human appearance. Common traits include animal ears and tails.

A subgroup of Thirens known as "Beast Thirens" are characterized by their more pronounced animalistic features, often possessing animalistic bone structures and bodies covered in fur. Some Thiren have been found to have a caffeine intolerance, with coffee consumption potentially leading to heart problems</ref>.

Abilities

Thirens exhibit superhuman abilities such as immense strength, improved adaptation to Hollows, faster mutation rates after exposure to corruption, and rapid recovery. For example,Ellen's tail can break bones if she is not careful. Though their abilities vary, many Thirens are skilled combatants, often utilizing their unique physical traits in battle.

Types

Bear Thiren

Bear Thiren are a distinct type of the larger Beast Thiren group. Known for their impressive size and intimidating presence, Bear Thiren are often mistaken for dangerous creatures. However, the common belief that they consume intelligent life forms is a myth[1].

Bear Thiren share many physical traits with other Beast Thirens, like their high "Ether aptitude," which surpasses that of most other people[2]. This attribute allows them to excel in Hollow-related jobs and activities, explaining why they are a top-pick for in-Hollow construction projects, with Bear Thirens comprising around 80% of Belobog Heavy Industries' staff[3].

Bear Thiren have made significant contributions to New Eridu, notably in the field of space exploration. Historical records reveal that there were Bear Thiren cosmonauts who ventured into space[4], showcasing their resilience and adaptability.

Bear Thiren are known for their calm demeanor and resistance to stress[5]. They maintain their composure under pressure, a trait that sets them apart from many other species. However, their patience has limits. Unlike Canine Thirens, who can often be placated with food, Bear Thiren require more than simple gestures to calm them[6]. When a Bear Thiren loses its temper, fleeing is the most prudent course of action, as they rarely show patience in confrontations[7].

Boar Thiren

Boar Thiren are red-skinned Beast Thiren with a variety of appearances. Some (like Big Daddy) are relatively humanoid, while others (like Grassy, Woody and Bricky) are much more pig-like, having short stature and being unable speak human languages. These Thiren also seem to be extremely durable and have high pain tolerances.

Canine Thiren

Feline Thiren

Fish Thiren

Fox Thiren

Ethereal-Slaying Katana: "Tailless"
A cursed blade originally wielded by the first head of the Hoshimi family and passed down from generation to generation. Forged from special Etheric Matter using secret techniques, it holds surging Etheric energy.
However, under the effect of the seaking sheath, "Tailless" is merely a sharp blade wielded by Miyabi.
Maybe only when the seal is lifted will we uncover the story behind this blade.

As visible in-game and mentioned by Yanagi in her journal, Miyabi's katana has a fingerprint lock to prevent others from unsheathing it.[1]

De ella sale un especie de espectro, uno pequeño tomando la forma de un ojo siendo el mismo que sale de la Katana maldita

Hoshimi Miyabi, the Chief of Hollow Special Operations Section 6.
Miyabi goes on a lot of field missions and still doesn't know which floor the regular monthly meeting is on.
Even if you see Miyabi in the office, it's unlikely she's dealing with paperwork, and more likely polishing her sword.

Being conferred the title of Void Hunter due to her outstanding contributions, she's an elite amongst elites in Section 6.
She has great prestige amongst the citizens.
Once, Miyabi accidentally wandered into a "Miyabi Fan Club" hosted offline event.
Miyabi was thought to be a fan with godlike impersonation skills, and that event resulted in a precious visual recording.

She is not simply a martial artist obsessed with her art and without care for the world around her.
Anyone who knows her will realize she's always pursued justice in her heart... even if it may eventually cause a revolution.

General

To unlock Hollow Zero, players must have an Inter-Knot Rank of Novice Proxy, and then complete the commission Earlybird Ticket to Safety. Once unlocked, players can access Hollow Zero from the Scott Outpost Interior.

Like other Hollows, exploration within Hollow Zero consists of a Bangboo being controlled around the Monitor Array. Unlike standard commissions however, Hollow Zero's Monitor Array exploration is procedurally-generated, with map configuration and events arranged differently with each playthrough.
Zones

Hollow Zero Zones v1
Available Zones in Hollow Zero as of v.1.0
Hollow Zero is currently divided into 6 Zones, referring to the different areas that can be visited within the Hollow. Each Zone has its own unique features, gimmicks and enemies that require players to approach exploration differently. Zones are further subdivided into difficulty levels, which from easiest to hardest are known as Edge, Frontline, Interior, Heartland and Core. Each difficulty increases the danger of traps and enemies within, in exchange for providing better rewards.

The Zones currently available in Hollow Zero include:

Qualification Assessment
Old Capital Metro
Construction Ruins
Abandoned Skyscraper
Withering Garden
Inferno Reap
Combat Bonuses and Restrictions

Squad Configuration

Before entering Hollow Zero, players need to designate one Agent to be the Leader, who starts exploration alone. At Edge difficulty, players can designate up to two other Agents as Backup, who can be recruited at select floors in Hollow Zero, using Random Call tiles. At higher difficulties, more Backup slots open up and thus more Agents can be set as Backup. When entering Stable Areas, the player can make a Random Call to one Backup Agent to come as reinforcements.

Pressure and Corruption

Every step taken in Hollow Zero will generate 10 Pressure, with the exception of special board tiles like Safety Zones. Once Pressure reaches 100, a random Corruption will appear and the current Pressure will be cleared. Corruption can have adverse effects on both combat and exploration. Players can check the details in the Corruption tab.

Resonia

Main articles: Resonia and Gear Coin
While exploring Hollow Zero, Agents may collect an assortment of Resonia. Resonia give your team various combat buffs or an exploration buffs. Open up your Resonium Inventory on the left to view all the Resonia you own, as well as their effects. Resonia can also be bought in Bangboo Shops in exchange for Gear Coins gathered during the Hollow Zero exploration, or picked up in certain mission-specific events.

This article is about the faction. For the district, see HAND Headquarters.
H.A.N.D. (Hollow Affairs & Neutralization Department) is a faction in Zenless Zone Zero. Not much is currently known about this organization.


Hollow Special Operations

The Hollow Special Operations is the armed force of H.A.N.D. dedicated towards responding to Hollow disasters. Their operatives are mainly seen at Scott Outpost.
Structure

Special Operations Department
Section 9
Section 6
Section 5
Section 3

All evil must be eradicated. What is "evil"? That's for us to judge.
Hollow Special Operations Section 6, abbreviated as H.S.O.S.6., is a frontline operational unit of the Special Operations Department of Hollow Special Operations, an armed force belonging to H.A.N.D.. It was single-handedly established by Hoshimi Miyabi.


Description

Hollow Special Operations is H.A.N.D.'s armed force dedicated to the response to Hollow disasters. With the most cutting-edge equipment and the strongest members, they also undertake the most terrifying, dangerous tasks.
They can be found in high-risk Hollow-related events and highly sensitive missions involving H.A.N.D.

Section 6 is one of the newly established frontline operational units of the Special Operations Department. Like other disciplined units under H.A.N.D., Section 6 is made up of a number of highly talented individuals. However, with Miyabi at its core, Section 6 is unique in every sense of the word.

Overview

Hollow Special Operations Section 6 (or just Section 6) is the most recently established unit of H.S.O, the armed subsidiary of H.A.N.D. Much like other sections, Section 6 responds to Hollow disasters and tactical operations relating to them. Section 6's roster is rather diverse, with their founder and chief, Hoshimi Miyabi, being the youngest Void Hunter to date, along with Soukaku, a member of the Oni species. Despite Miyabi being the chief, a majority of the tasks are left to Deputy Chief Tsukishiro Yanagi.

Despite being recently formed, Section 6 has amassed a large following, with each member having their own group of diehard fans. They also have a workplace rivalry with Section 5.

Members:

Hoshimi Miyabi- Capitana

Yanagi- Sub capitana

Soukaku

Harumasa

New Eridu is a miracle in an age of Hollow disasters, and should be everyone's only choice!
The New Eridu City Administration is the government of New Eridu and a faction in Zenless Zone Zero. They have control over the Hollow Investigative Association, New Eridu Public Security, and the New Eridu Defense Force.

In addition to running the city, they are also in charge of protecting citizens from Hollows. They have been cracking down on both Hollow Raiders and Proxies, considering them to be threats to New Eridu.[1]

New Eridu is the last surviving city after contemporary civilization was destroyed by the Hollows. New Eridu managed to survive and thrive after the apocalypse by acquiring the technology to be able to extract resources out of the Hollows. Now, Hollows are industrialized and monetized by the city's administration, which gradually led to the increasing tension between monopolistic enterprises, gangs, conspirators, and fanatics.[1]


Overview

New Eridu appears to be a bustling city with many activities and careers taking place in it. Featuring a wide variety of people, shops, locations and more. Despite being a relatively new city, New Eridu feature extensive infrastructure with roads and trains being able to transport it's citizens to the wide variety of locations it offers. The technology in the city appears to be a blend of both retro and futuristic technology, such as advanced computer systems running on arrays of CRT televisions for its display or music record players and VHS tapes being the medium of choice for entertainment for most residents despite the presence of data file storage devices. New Eridu appears to take many inspirations from real life cities in Asia such as Shanghai, Hong Kong and Tokyo.

The Hollow Investigative Association (HIA) is an organization affiliated with the New Eridu City Administration, and a faction in Zenless Zone Zero. [1] They are primarily responsible for Hollow disaster response within New Eridu, assisting with Hollow containment and disaster-related matters.[2] Investigators regularly complete official commissions such as rescues and Ethereal hunts. Unlike Proxies, the investigators of the Association are legally accredited by the city administration.

The HIA recruits many individuals with high Ether aptitude to complete risky work. The HIA Career Club allows prospective investigators to compete in combat simulations and judge whether or not they are field-ready.

The HIA also works with Scott Outpost, where they help direct the containment of Hollow Zero.


Ranks

The promotion path for Investigators is:

Trainee Investigator
Full Investigator
Senior Investigator
Elite Investigator
Ace Investigator
With each promotion, an investigator shall face more pressure and danger, resulting in few being able to make it to the top and become an Ace.

HIA recruits without high Ether aptitude are unable to advance far, and are usually relegated to doing office or logistical work. Meanwhile, many less capable investigators perish in the Hollow, or are left unable to work from the long-term effects of Ether corruption.

New Eridu Public Security (NEPS) is a police organization under the New Eridu City Administration tasked with maintaining peace and order within New Eridu.

NEPS is responsible for most of New Eridu's administrative and judicial needs. They have branches all over the city, including a major one at NEPS Lumina Branch.


Departments

Metropolitan Order Department

Responsible for public order within the city. The Criminal Investigation Special Response Team conducts regular patrols, raises safety awareness, and deals with criminals such as Hollow Raiders, gangsters, fraudsters, and Proxies.

General Affairs Department

Processes most administrative forms and documents, and deals with general violations and daily order issues.

Traffic Department

Deals with traffic-related issues such as vehicle violations and traffic document handling.

Hollow Affairs Department

Responsible for Hollow-related issues. The Hollow Affairs Department keeps civilians away from Hollows within the city, and often enters Companion Hollows for rescue operations, criminal pursuits, or to assist the Hollow Investigative Association.

Contemporary civilization has been destroyed by a supernatural disaster known as the “Hollows”. They grow exponentially out of thin air, creating disordered dimensions where mysterious monsters dubbed the “Ethereal” roam. New Eridu, the last urban civilization that survived the apocalypse, managed to thrive by acquiring the technology to extract valuable resources out of the Hollows.
https://www.hoyoverse.com/en-us/news/102144
Hollows are supernatural disasters in Zenless Zone Zero. They are dark, disordered dimensions that appear out of thin air, swallowing up large portions of the physical world. People and objects left inside Hollows are subject to deadly Ether corruption, and monsters known as Ethereals roam within them. Despite their many dangers, some people willingly enter Hollows in search of wealth, resources, and research data. Proxies help guide these people in their exploration of Hollows, often breaking the law to do so[1]

Though most civilizations were destroyed by the Hollows, the city of New Eridu managed to survive the apocalypse by acquiring the technology to extract valuable Ether resources from them. Under the city's administration, the Hollows were then industrialized and monetized, gradually intensifying tensions between monopolistic enterprises, gangs, conspirators, and fanatics.[1]


Description

Hollows are an apocalyptic-level disaster, an abnormal spherical dimension that appears out of thin air swallowing everything they touch. The internal space-time environment becomes disorderly due to unknown influences, and dangerous mutant creatures known as the "Ethereal" are produced. Ordinary people lost in the Hollows face not only the horror of being attacked by monsters, but have to risk the corruption and eventual mutation.
New Eridu Settler's Guide
Hollows are characterized by their black, spherical appearances. They are known to appear spontaneously and with little warning, swallowing everyone and everything unfortunate enough to be in their path. Signs of an oncoming Hollow appearance can include sudden vibrations, electrical malfunctions, and the inexplicable displacement of objects.

Larger Hollows can cause the formation of smaller Companion Hollows once they reach an Ether threshold called the "Zenless Limit".[2]
Ethereals

Main article: Ethereals
Once they have spawned, Hollows begin to create Ether-based monsters known as Ethereals. Although Ethereals have not been known to leave their Hollows, they still pose a serious threat to anyone within.

Miguel Silver Dullahan
A group of Ethereals within the Hollow.
Hollows are sustained by Ether energy, which is directly linked to the Ethereals residing within them. It is possible to reduce the size of a Hollow by destroying a massive number of regular Ethereals, or by eliminating a particularly large one. If continuously suppressed, a Hollow may even gradually shrink until it disappears.[3]

Corruption

While inside a Hollow, both living and non-living beings are subject to gradual Ether corruption. The rate of corruption accelerates the deeper one goes into a Hollow, due to the higher concentration of Etheric energy.

Miguel Silver Corrupted
A heavily-corrupted Miguel Silver.
Objects and structures within Hollows will slowly degrade, warping and weakening their appearances. Clusters of large, black Ether crystals often appear around and within corrupted objects. Small objects can be preserved by storing them in anti-corruption serum.[4]

NEPS Armor
Anti-corruption armor used by New Eridu Public Security.
Humans and humanoids who stay inside Hollows too long are eventually afflicted with Ether corruption. Corruption causes rapid mutations in a person's physiology, including the growth of dark, painful crystals throughout their body; the formation of a distinctive Ether "core"; and a gradual loss of sanity.[5] Corrupted individuals will eventually transform completely into Ethereals. There is no known cure for Ether corruption, with current treatments only able to reverse mild cases.[6] Even victims who escape full Ethereal transformation are likely to suffer life-altering health problems.

Individuals are corrupted at rates relative to their Ether aptitude. Those with high Ether aptitude can stay in Hollows unprotected for longer periods of time without suffering the effects of corruption.[7] Those with low aptitude can still explore Hollows by using anti-corruption serum and by wearing specialized equipment. Anti-corruption gear is commonly used by New Eridu Public Security, the Hollow Investigative Association, the New Eridu Defense Force, and bandits.

Both intelligent and non-intelligent machines can be corrupted, though their natural Ether resistance is higher.

Environment

Hollow Interior
The interior of a Hollow.
The once-ordinary interiors of Hollows are drastically altered by Ether, turning them into mazes of distorted environments. Within Hollows, normal rules don't apply; a seemingly-straightforward path could be riddled with invisible fissures and blockages, while what looks like a dead end could contain a portal out of the Hollow. Some Hollows even seem to be interconnected — passing through a fissure in one Hollow may lead one into an entirely different Hollow.[8] Communication with the outside world is nearly impossible from within a Hollow, with only the legendary proxy Phaethon being able to reliably do so.[9]

Hollows are naturally complex places, and being careless can lead to death for inexperienced and experienced explorers alike. To safely explore Hollows, many explorers use Bangboo, small robots equipped with Carrot programs. These programs create maps of Hollows that can guide explorers along safer routes, minimize their time spent in the Hollow and help avoid dangerous Ethereals.

Dangers

According to the New Eridu City Administration, there are various dangers one can encounter while in a Hollow:

Ethereals: mutant monsters that attack all foreign living creatures.
Ether: a substance that is as ubiquitous as air, with great energy potential but deadly corruptive effects.
The Corrupted: Individuals can become corrupted by the aforementioned Ether, slowly mutating and losing their conscious thoughts.
Lawless Thugs: Criminals who seek to rob other explorers for profit.
Hollow Raiders, Proxies, and other unsanctioned explorers.
Effects on Society

Most contemporary civilizations were unable to survive the spontaneous appearances of Hollows. The citizens of Eridu, however, were able to harness the Hollows' Ether as an energy source, allowing the city to thrive in the face of the apocalypse. Though Eridu was eventually consumed by Hollow Zero, its survivors rebuilt in what would become the city of New Eridu.

Ballet Twins Hollow
New Eridu continues to operate despite the Hollows.
Energy Production

To generate usable power, advanced pipe networks extract Etheric matter from existing Hollows. The absorbed Etheric energy is then converted into electricity, while any leftover Ether corruption is released into the air through a process called "Shiyu". This purification takes place at specialized pillars located in and around the city, where monsters created by the corruption are regularly purged.[10]

MB Picture Sibling 4
The Shiyu Pillars.
Ether appears to be an incredibly potent power source, with most buildings, vehicles, and appliances in New Eridu using it as fuel. Ether corporations have yet to extend their reach beyond the city, where rural residents and biker gangs still use diesel fuel.[11]

Safety and Security

Though Hollows have enabled the city to thrive, the residents of New Eridu are still well-aware of their dangers. A large part of New Eridu Public Security's work revolves around Hollow-related incidents, including rescuing citizens trapped by new Companion Hollows; dealing with criminals who use Hollows as hideouts; and even managing traffic incidents caused by Hollow appearances.[12][13] They also arrest and prosecute Hollow Raiders and Proxies who illegally enter Hollows.

The Hollow Investigative Association is the organization primarily responsible for managing Hollow disaster-related matters. Their Investigators complete official commissions, such as rescues and Ethereal hunts, for a fee.[14] The Association regularly recruits citizens with high Ether aptitudes to become Investigators, training them extensively in Hollow exploration and combat.

Multiple elite agencies collaborate to research and suppress the most dangerous Hollows, especially Hollow Zero. These include H.A.N.D.; the New Eridu Defense Force's Obsidian Division; and the White Star Institute.

Hollow Raiders

Main article: Hollow Raiders
Hollow Raider Thugs
A group of bandits wearing corruption-resistant armor.
Many people who explore Hollows do not do so legally. Groups known as "Hollow Raiders" regularly enter Hollows for variety of reasons. Some are hardened criminals who use Hollows to evade the law, and who assault and rob other explorers. Others are freelancers, mercenaries, independent investigators, and Proxies who complete private commissions not sanctioned by the Hollow Investigative Association. Many Hollow Raiders use the online service Inter-Knot to communicate and to post commissions.

Known Hollows

Hollow Zero

Main article: Hollow Zero
Hollow Zero, also known as "Limbo," is a colossal Hollow that consumed the old city of Eridu, resulting in its destruction. It is the source of many of the Hollows in and around New Eridu. The investigation and suppression of Hollow Zero pose a long-term challenge for the authorities of New Eridu.

Original Hollows

The original Hollows, also known as primary Hollows, are a set of six Hollows within New Eridu. They are large in scale, have complex environments, and contain Ethereals of varying strengths.

Name	Description
Cretan Hollow
Cretan Hallow
Located on the border of the Janus Quarter, Cretan Hollow neighbors the desolate old capital area. Its impact on citizens' daily lives is relatively minor, but it still often causes disaster alerts in the eastern districts.
"Long had the throne fallen, with beasts caged in eternal struggle. And the gods as ever watch in silence." - A verse was carved onto the wall of a deserted tunnel in the old metro swallowed by the Cretan Hollow.
Lemnian Hollow
Lemnian Hallow
Located in the northwest of the Old Capital Isthmus, Lemnian Hollow resides at a considerable distance from the citizens of New Eridu. However, it is also the most active among its six siblings in New Eridu and the residential areas are frequently troubled by the presence of its Companion Hollows.

I was once told a legend from the old civilization: Amidst the isles of Lemnian, our ancestors raised grand temples and sacred shrines. But in the new world, this story looks different: Deep in the depths of Lemnian lies an abyss, infested with the nests and lairs of the evil. Cease your prayers. Cease your prayers.

The Hollow Raiders is a term used to describe individuals who enter the Hollows without authorization from the Hollow Investigative Association. Multiple factions in Zenless Zone Zero include Hollow Raiders.[1]


Description

Hollow Raiders enter the Hollows uncovering mysteries or finding treasures, such as Ether resources. Navigating the Hollows requires the use of a Bangboo that is modified to recognize Carrots, which are time-sensitive data used to map a safe route through the Hollow. Hollow Raiders usually acquire Carrots distributed by Proxies, and often work alongside a Proxy to complete Commissions.

The majority of Hollow Raiders have a high Ether Aptitude, allowing them to survive in the Hollows for some time without suffering corruption. Most Hollow Raiders are armed and prepared for combat, mainly against Ethereals. They can obtain useful supplies (Resonia) from Bangboo Merchants deployed within the Hollows.

Hollow Raiders use Inter-Knot, an online service which acts as a forum as well as a place to post Commissions.

Hollow Raiders avoid interacting with Hollow Investigators and Public Security officials, since these factions may arrest the Raiders, but under some circumstances they may join forces. Interactions between Hollow Raiders are also uncertain, so most Raiders will be wary of others.

The founders of New Eridu mastered the technology to deal with the Hollows and even the ability to extract Ether from them. The entire city's prosperity relies on this precious resource, a magic exclusive to New Eridu!
The City Life
 Icon Ether is one of the six attributes of Zenless Zone Zero.

Ether also refers to a substance extracted from Hollows which powers New Eridu. Ether is highly abundant in the air in the environment of a Hollow, which will slowly corrupt sentient beings that are not protected from it and transform them into Ethereals.


Combat

Dealing Ether DMG to enemies accumulates Ether Anomaly Buildup, which triggers the Corruption effect.
Targets attacked during Corruption take bonus Ether DMG intermittently.
Inflicting Corruption on enemies weak to Ether can interrupt their actions.
Ether Corruption Treatment

Progress in Ether Corruption Medical Treatments&mdash-;Jonathan Medicinal advances: research team can partially reverse the corruption of the Ether. Current technology only treats small corrupted areas, exposed for short periods. There are still many technological advances to be made to meet public expectations when it comes to dealing with corruption and restoring damaged devices.

Bangboo were originally created to assist New Eridu residents with evacuation in Hollow disasters. When a Hollow occurs in New Eridu's residential areas, Bangboo will immediately receive disaster information and evacuation guidance from the public network, and help people around them avoid the hazard-prone areas.
Now, thanks to technological advancement and emerging diverse needs, Bangboo have evolved from simple helper intelligent devices for disaster avoidance to more comprehensive and versatile intelligent individuals. Some pro version Bangboo even go deep into Hollows with Investigators and help with various operations.
New Eridu Settlers Guide, Vol. 3 — The Bangboo
Bangboo were invented by "Sunbringer", formerly the head of the Marcel Group. Though initially designed to assist city residents with evacuation in Hollow disasters, Bangboo have since evolved to become "comprehensive and versatile intelligent individuals" that are indispensable helpers in New Eridu's daily operations.[1] They are currently built by the Marcel Group for a variety of purposes, and they are commonly seen in all parts of New Eridu.

Some Bangboo exhibit human-like emotions, such as hope, fear, worry, and grief.[2][3] They have been seen to converse and collaborate with each other without human intervention.[4] However, unlike Intelligent Constructs, Bangboo do not have free will, and they are not eligible for New Eridu citizenship.[5] Bangboo without masters are legally required to be scrapped.[6]

The Bangboo are mechanical in nature and require charging. Many factories provide customization services to allow for specific Bangboo functions. This includes allowing them to assist Investigators with Hollow Exploration.[1]
Bangboo N.E.T.

Bangboo Net Loading
There seems to be something called the Bangboo N.E.T. (Special Internet Network for Bangboo)

Appearance

Most Bangboo are short and stout, only around knee-height.[1] They have ears resembling bunny ears on the top of their heads, and a black screen for a face, which can display coloured circles as eyes. Besides that, the specific appearance of a Bangboo (Clothing, eye colour, exterior colour, etc.) can vary greatly. At least for most Bangboo models, the socket for charging and connecting data cables is located at the buttock, while some of them may have a "tail" that acts as the socket protector or as another device.



Combat Bangboo

Combat Bangboo are obtainable units in Zenless Zone Zero. As a companion in battle, each Combat Bangboo has unique abilities. In addition to using active skills to support Agents in battle, some Combat Bangboo will also have an additional Bangboo Chain Attack. Bangboo Chain Attacks don't count toward the total number of Chain Attacks and have a cooldown. They cannot be activated consecutively for a period of time.

Proxies are individuals who guide those who enter the Hollows.[1] Unlike their counterparts at the Hollow Investigative Association, Proxies are not accredited by the New Eridu City Administration, and their work is outside the boundaries of the law. They often complete jobs too risky or shady for the HIA to take on.

Proxies are the successors of the Void Hunters and they were loosely bonded together by the Proxy Network (aka Inter-Knot), an online platform where users can share advice and post or accept commissions. Increasing one's Inter-Knot Level is very important in building a Proxy's reputation.

The most famous Proxy within New Eridu is Phaethon, a sibling duo who achieved "Legendary" Inter-Knot status prior to their account credentials being stolen by someone else.

The Void Hunters is a title given by the mayor of Eridu to key players in the suppression of the Hollows, serving as predecessors to the Proxies.


Overview

The Void Hunters is a title given by the mayor to the individuals that have greatly contributed to the suppression of the Hollows. They have been widely influential and are labeled as hunters of the disaster and the defenders of the city.

Many ages ago before the existence of Proxies, there are eight people served to become the first and original Void Hunters.

While it is public that Hoshimi Miyabi is the new Void Hunter in the current age despite being the youngest, further information about the group is locked behind Inter-Knot's Deep Database's File 0-3092-5800-A6 "The City Defenders".

The New Eridu Defense Force is a military organization under the New Eridu City Administration. They are tasked with protecting New Eridu from external threats, primarily Hollows.

Not much is currently known about the Defense Force. They operate Scott Outpost, helping protect New Eridu by containing Hollow Zero. They have also been seen working in conjunction with H.A.N.D.

Rebel Soldiers are rogue members of the Defense Force who act for various private interests, or who have become bandits.


Structure

Typical Defense Force squads consist of light infantry (Jaegers), heavily-armored assault units (Gunners), and armed tactical mechs (Strikers, Rovers, Guardians, and Typhons).

Although the Defense Force once had multiple divisions, all but the Obsidian Division were wiped out when Eridu was destroyed by Hollow Zero.[1]
